property_summary: For any caller and any positive ether value sent to receive(), the reference C always increments depositsCount (so depositsCount after the call >= 1), whereas the mutant rejects the very first deposit by requiring depositsCount > 0 and thus can revert or leave depositsCount unchanged for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require condition to a stricter check that prevents increment when depositsCount is zero (i.e., require depositsCount > 0 before incrementing).
